title: 第3章 真当郊游了第4章 激活系统
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
分配完队伍之后，巡逻队队员就带着一众学生离开了村子。
越过木质围栏，不少人的心中都是出现了一丝不安。
毕竟很多人长这么大，还是第一次踏出形守村的地界。
“这次巡逻总共需要两天时间，具体任务，你们负责的队员会安排好的，你们只需要听从指挥就行了。”
王路冷冷说道。
丘凌风等人的小队正是由王路带领的。
另一个巡逻队队员修为是通脉境三段，名为叶成。
有了这两位高手领头，众人明显安心了不少。
尤其是王敏，已经没有最初这么紧张了，松开了挽着张悦的手臂。
不过丘凌风可不会因此放松警惕，在前身的记忆之中，他能够很清楚的了解到。
普通人在魔兽面前，是多么的无力弱小。
“你们别高兴得太早，我们巡逻的地方，是最危险的暗森林外围。”
王路看着丘凌风等人，开口说道。
而后，众人就离开了村子，前往各自的巡逻地点。
丘凌风背着背包，走在队伍的最后边。
王敏倒是没有多少负重，基本上都交给了张悦。
张悦是通脉境一段的武者，可以轻松举起两百斤重的物体。
所以他帮忙带着王敏的物资也不是什么难事。
“我好累啊，队长，我们能歇一歇吗？”
走了快有一个小时之后，王敏就撑不住了，喊起了累。

“闭嘴，继续走！”
王路可没有答应。
他们的任务可是巡逻，检查形守村附近有没有新的魔兽出现。
而不是游山玩水的，哪能随便停下来休息？
“小敏，你要是累了的话，我来背着你吧。”
张悦跑了过去，说道。
“可是悦哥你还要背物资呢，不如让阿文和小凡轮流背我吧。”
王敏摇了摇头，似乎是在为张悦考虑。
她口中的两人，正是队伍里另外两个男生，本名分别叫周文，周小凡。
“这……好吧，只要小敏你别累着就行。”
张悦有些纠结，不过实在不忍心王敏受苦，点头道。
得到张悦应允之后，王敏就很自觉的爬上了周文的背上，顺便将周文的物资丢给了张悦。
“悦哥，阿文他要背我，腾不出手，你就顺便带一下他的物资吧？”
王敏用着嗲嗲的语气，撒娇道。
“好。”
content_en:
After the teams were assigned, the patrol members left the village with a group of students.
After crossing the wooden fence, many people felt a little uneasy in their hearts.
After all, this is the first time for many people who have grown up to step outside the boundaries of Xingshou Village.
"This patrol will take a total of two days. The specific tasks will be arranged by your team members. You just need to follow the instructions."
Wang Lu said coldly.
Qiu Lingfeng and others' team was led by Wang Lu.
Another member of the patrol is at the third level of Tongmai Realm, named Ye Cheng.
With these two experts taking the lead, everyone felt much more at ease.
Especially Wang Min, who was no longer as nervous as he was at first, let go of Zhang Yue's arm.
However, Qiu Lingfeng will not let down his guard because of this. He can clearly understand it in the memory of his predecessor.
Ordinary people are so powerless and weak in front of monsters.
"Don't be too happy. The place we patrol is on the outskirts of the most dangerous dark forest."
Wang Lu looked at Qiu Lingfeng and others and said.
Then, everyone left the village and headed to their respective patrol locations.
Qiu Lingfeng was carrying a backpack and walking at the end of the team.
Wang Min didn't have much weight to bear, and basically left it to Zhang Yue.
Zhang Yue is a warrior at the first level of Tongmai Realm and can easily lift objects weighing two hundred kilograms.
Therefore, it was not difficult for him to help carry Wang Min's supplies.
"I'm so tired, Captain, can we take a break?"
After walking for almost an hour, Wang Min couldn't hold on anymore and cried out that he was tired.
"Shut up and keep walking!"
Wang Lu did not agree.
Their mission is to patrol and check whether there are any new monsters near Xingshou Village.
Instead of traveling around, how can you stop and rest casually?
"Xiao Min, if you are tired, I will carry you."
Zhang Yue ran over and said.
"But Brother Yue, you still have to carry supplies, why not let Awen and Xiaofan take turns carrying me."
Wang Min shook his head, seeming to be thinking about Zhang Yue.
The two people she mentioned were the other two boys in the team, whose real names were Zhou Wen and Zhou Xiaofan.
"This... okay, as long as Xiao Min doesn't get tired."
Zhang Yue was a little tangled, but he really couldn't bear Wang Min's suffering, so he nodded.
After getting Zhang Yue's consent, Wang Min consciously climbed onto Zhou Wen's back and threw Zhou Wen's supplies to Zhang Yue.
"Brother Yue, Awen wants to carry me on his back and has no spare time, so why don't you just take his supplies with you?"
Wang Min said coquettishly in a coquettish tone.
"good."
